faqs.question: What is a crypto airdrop?
faqs.answer: Airdrops are free token distributions to early users, holders, or community members. Used to decentralize ownership, reward users, and create awareness for new projects.

faqs.question: How do I qualify for airdrops?
faqs.answer: Use protocols early, maintain activity over time, participate in testnets, hold relevant tokens/NFTs, and engage with the community. Sybil detection is common - quality over quantity matters.

faqs.question: Are airdrops taxable?
faqs.answer: In most jurisdictions, airdrops are taxed as income when received and capital gains when sold. Record the fair market value at time of airdrop. Consult a tax professional.
